verdict.rationale: Jan's own docs say users can give it a natural-language task that it carries out autonomously across files, commands and web research. It also offers MCP tool calls with inline approval and browser automation via Jan Browser MCP. However, there is no evidence that the product itself (model management, settings, assistants, server configuration) can be operated through natural-language commands, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: natural-language control of Jan's own app functions and settings, independent or hands-on corroboration of the autonomous task mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Give Jan a task and it works on it autonomously — files, commands, and web research.
Approval panels appear inline inside the tool card in the chat, showing the exact arguments the model wants to pass before you accept or deny.
